course_name_original: Virtuelle Menschmodelle für Sport, Medizin und Technik
course_name_en: Virtual Human Models for Sports, Medicine and Technology

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the theoretical foundations of virtual human and musculoskeletal models.
Discretize the musculoskeletal system and create simple musculoskeletal calculation models.
Describe and evaluate the influence of muscle activation and muscle recruitment on biomechanical quantities.
Independently model problems from ergonomics, sports, and medicine using virtual human models.
Critically analyze, interpret, and evaluate the results of musculoskeletal simulations.
Recognize and classify the limitations, assumptions, and uncertainties of modeling.

syllabus_topics: Mechanical basic elements of the human body
Model creation and validation of musculoskeletal models
Integration of musculoskeletal simulations with motion analysis, imaging, and finite element calculations
Execution of an individual musculoskeletal calculation project
bibliography: UCHIDA, Thomas K., Scott L. DELP und David B. DELP, 2020. Biomechanics of movement: the science of sports, robotics, and rehabilitation. Cambridge, Massachusetts ; London, England: The MIT Press. ISBN 978-0-262-04420-2
